stem_book: Ionisation enthalpy of nitrogen is more than oxygen because of (a) extra stability of half filled orbitals (b) more number of energy levels (c) less number of valence electrons (d) smaller size.
key: a extra stability of half filled orbitals
derived: a extra stability of half filled orbitals
correct_answer: a extra stability of half filled orbitals
work: N 2p³ half-filled (exchange-stabilised); O 2p⁴ loses a paired electron easily → IE(N) > IE(O)
